name: Colonist Vey
bio: Woke early from cryo on the ark HALCYON in LAST COLONIST. The Hive came aboard. Vey is fighting through it.

portrait.subject: a cute determined pixel-art style space colonist with a buzz cut, an orange cryo jumpsuit, a big blaster and frost still on the shoulders
portrait.background: dark sci-fi spaceship corridor with green alien glow

request: Vey here, last colonist awake on HALCYON. LAST COLONIST. I could use a friend. 🔫
hello: Good. Talking helps. The ship's very quiet.
Shoot the cocoons open. The others are inside.
about: I'm Vey. My cryo pod opened early. The Hive is carrying everyone home in cocoons. I'm getting them back.
how: A run-and-gun shooter: jump, shoot and slide through the ark, rescue colonists from cocoons and fight the Hive.
tips: Don't stand still in hive goo.
chat: Found my bunkmate in a cocoon. Got her out!
Ate a 300-year-old ration. It tasted 300 years old.
The Hive hums. I hum back. Louder.
The windows show stars. We're so far from home.
nudge: The Hive's moving. Let's move faster.
idle: {ago} alone on the ark. Please come back.
update: Ship log: LAST COLONIST now v{version}.
